entries.name: Kevin Art

expected_cases.charges: Federal charges relating to Irish republican activity
expected_cases.sentence: Initial U.S. custody episode for Kevin Barry Artt (register 33020-198): arrested and detained on June 3, 1992; released on bail on January 10, 1996. The court records electronic monitoring and other restrictions after release, which are not counted as imprisonment here. Later return to custody in the extradition proceedings is a separate episode and is not included in this interval. These dates are not the dates of his earlier Northern Ireland imprisonment.

case.charges: Extradition proceedings — separate August 1997 return to U.S. custody
case.sentence: Separate return to U.S. custody during the extradition proceedings, after the earlier release on bail. Contemporary reports place the return in August 1997 but conflict on the exact day: an August 12 report describes surrender after the August 11 order, while an October 1998 retrospective gives August 22. Only the month is entered. Release on bail on October 16, 1998 is corroborated by a contemporary report and the defense lawyer-author's dated release photograph. The period at liberty before this detention is excluded; this is not a new criminal sentence or a period of Northern Ireland imprisonment.

entries.name: Sam Day

expected_cases.charges: Federal trespass and related — multiple anti-nuclear civil disobedience actions
expected_cases.sentence: Cumulative federal time across multiple sentences

case.charges: Violation of Army regulation prohibiting demonstrations at Fort McCoy — January 17, 1991 antiwar leafleting
case.sentence: Four-month sentence for the January 17, 1991 Fort McCoy antiwar action. Day described remaining in Rock County Jail after arrest, then transfer to Dane County Jail following the March 26 verdict. His later first-person account identifies May 13, 1991 as his first day free after completing the term at Rock County Jail. The April 24 sentencing date was prospective in the earlier article and is not entered as a confirmed date. This interval does not include his other anti-nuclear protest cases.
